title: Add autonomy summary publication command
summary: The autonomous workflow can generate and validate summaries, but routine sprint publication still requires operators to redirect stdout and hand-check drift. Add a bounded local publication command with check mode so sprint summaries can be written or verified repeatably without touching Git metadata.
expectedFailureModes: The command writes outside the repository or into Git metadata.
Check mode can pass when the published file has drifted from the generated summary.
Docs imply review artifacts are signed or publicly published before key custody exists.
nextAction: Add a local autonomy summary publication command, validate its write/check behavior, and document the routine sprint-summary publication path without claiming signed review artifacts.
